title: oxypetalum coeruleum
intro: Oxypetalum coeruleum, commonly known as Blue Passion Flower, is a species of flowering plant in the family Apocynaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including anxiety, insomnia, and inflammation, due to its potential health benefits such as acting as an anxiolytic and sleep aid. The therapeutic actions of Oxypetalum coeruleum include sedative and anti-anxiety effects, attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds. Further research is needed to confirm the extent of its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
